built.note: Graph-first build ('One BI Team, Two Companies') for an SE architecture review with an engaged 3-month self-serve Dagster trial user (Raffaele Vumbaca's shared BI team across Noleggiare and Tomasi Auto, FTH Group). 14 assets across noleggiare_rental_ops/tomasi_dealer_ops (3 each, badged postgres) / shared_finance_warehouse (5, badged postgres) / ml_workflows (1, badged python) / bi_publish (1, badged qlik) / future_state_snowflake (1, badged snowflake) -- the brief's own '(~16-20 assets)' sizing note doesn't match its explicit 14-item enumeration; built the named list, flagged the discrepancy (same precedent as demos/trafigura, demos/rvu-tempcover). fact_finance_consolidated_daily and its Snowflake-variant twin are date x company MultiPartitionsDefinition-partitioned with plain deps= on differently single-Daily-partitioned upstream facts -- verified empirically (no explicit PartitionMapping needed) and recorded in LEARNINGS.md, a first for this repo. 3 checks (2 blocking, incl. a cross-company VIN double-count check on dim_vehicle), 1 freshness policy, eager automation on the warehouse layer, one 04:00 UTC schedule for the ingestion+per-company-fact layer only (the multi-partitioned consolidated fact cascades via automation instead). qlik_cloud_export carries a real demo/live network seam per the brief's explicit directive (QlikCloudExportComponent, new custom component -- no registry component covers Qlik Cloud, only the unrelated Qlik Compose product; component-feedback/2026-09-03-qlik-cloud-export.md) -- every other asset body is pass. First deploy attempt failed on 'No module named pex' because uv sync was never re-run after dagster-cloud was added to pyproject.toml mid-build; fixed by re-running uv sync and redeploying. Full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh copy with no env vars set.

REBUILD (fixes PR #15 defect): the prior build routed Fivetran and Power BI through a home-made GraphFirstAssetsComponent instead of the real integrations, despite the brief naming both explicitly -- flagged in requests/done/rvu-tempcover-2026-09-03.md. This rebuild subclasses the real, native dagster_fivetran.FivetranAccountComponent and dagster_powerbi.PowerBIWorkspaceComponent (both already follow the workspace-component convention) with a demo-mode I/O seam per templates/demo_mode_pattern.py -- write_state_to_path (discovery) and execute/build_semantic_model_refresh_asset_definition (sync/refresh) are the only mocked methods; asset keys, specs, checks, and YAML schema are unchanged from live-account output. Braze has no registry or native component (3 distinct searches, zero hits -- component-feedback/2026-09-03-braze-export.md) so it stays a plain demo-mode-mocked @asset, per the brief's own fallback. Same 12-asset graph/dbt project/checks/freshness/automation as the reverted build ('From Ran to Right'): 4 ingestion badged fivetran, 6 dbt badged dbt+bigquery (3 staging, dim_partner, 2 daily-partitioned facts, real dbt Core against DuckDB, 13 native tests + 2 custom checks incl. 1 blocking), 1 activation badged braze, 1 reporting badged powerbi (modeled as its refreshable semantic model -- the real triggerable action underneath a Power BI report). Fivetran observation sensor turned on (polling_sensor: true, default off). Full validation gate green (dg check defs/yaml, dg list defs, validate_e2e.py, preflight); verified zero-setup from a genuinely fresh clone.

Graph-first, always-green build ('One Ledger, Every Desk') for a 30-minute slot with no AE discovery notes and an unconfirmed audience -- the calendar invite lists zero Trafigura attendees, flagged prominently in README/DEMO_SCRIPT/notification. 10 assets (3 market_data + 2 trade_capture ingestion badged s3, 4 risk_warehouse badged redshift, 1 reporting badged powerbi) -- the brief's own '(~12-14 assets)' sizing note doesn't match its explicit 10-item enumeration; built the named list, flagged the discrepancy. 3 checks (2 blocking), 1 freshness policy on fact_credit_exposure_daily, eager automation on the warehouse layer, one EOD schedule (22:00 UTC, an invented deadline -- no single close time is confirmed across Trafigura's Singapore/Geneva/Houston/Montevideo/Mumbai desks). Reused detroit-dwsd's GraphFirstAssetsComponent verbatim rather than re-deriving the same registry gap (component-feedback/2026-08-28-graph-first-assets.md). Full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh copy.

No I/O at all (asset bodies are pass), so no demo_mode toggle exists for this build. New GraphFirstAssetsComponent (registry gap recorded in component-feedback/2026-08-28-graph-first-assets.md) covers the no-op-body pattern; a native build_schedule_from_partitioned_job call replaces the registry cron_schedule component, which can't express a local hour alongside a partitions_def. Full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh clone.

Sixth build, against the fifth-rewrite brief's migration-both-states directive. raw_dealer_floorplan_feed and raw_credit_bureau_pull are now genuine external AssetSpecs with zero Dagster-owned compute (defs/legacy_assets/legacy_assets.py), observed -- never triggered -- by a dedicated legacy_scheduler_observer sensor, and consumed downstream by dim_dealer/dim_borrower, so lineage actually crosses the legacy/Fabric boundary in the graph, not just in a metadata label (the gap PR #11 had). validate_e2e.py proves zero Dagster-triggered materializations ever occur for the two legacy assets. 17 assets total (2 legacy, 15 Fabric-migrated); full validation gate green; verified zero-setup from a fresh clone.
